```{r}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(ggplot2)
#install.packages("writexl")
library (writexl)
```


```{r}
# 1) Load + standardize column names
df<- read_excel("~/Ad_Planta_Trials/Raw_data/Field trial/Fieldtrial_results_diseasescore_two.xlsx") %>%
  rename(
    Treatment = Treatment,
    Month     = Month,
    Block     = Block,
    Plant     = Plant,
    score     = `Disease severity score`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Fix non-numeric entries
    score = case_when(
      trimws(as.character(score)) %in% c("p", "", " ") ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(score)
    ),
    # Relevel so Healthy control is reference
    Treatment = relevel(as.factor(Treatment), ref = "Non-treated control"),
    Month     = factor(Month, levels = c("August", "September")),
    Block     = as.factor(Block),
    Plant     = as.factor(Plant),
    # Ordered factor for ordinal model
    score_ord = factor(score, levels = 0:5, ordered = TRUE)
  )

View(df)
# Check cleaning worked
cat("=== Missing values ===\n")
df %>% filter(is.na(score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Treatment, Month, Block, Plant, score)

cat("\n=== Score distribution by Month ===\n")
df %>% count(score_ord, Month)

cat("\n=== Sample size per Treatment x Month ===\n")
df %>%
  filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
  count(Treatment, Month)
```

Step 2: Fit ordinal mixed model
```{r}
install.packages("ordinal")
library(ordinal)

# Full model with Treatment x Month interaction
# Block random effect accounts for field variation
# Plant nested in Block accounts for within-block variation
m_ord <- clmm(
  score_ord ~ Treatment * Month + (1|Block/Plant),
  data   = df %>% filter(!is.na(score_ord)),
  link   = "logit",
  Hess   = TRUE
)

summary(m_ord)


```

Diagnostics
```{r}
library(ordinal)

df_use <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(score_ord))

# Fixed-effects version for PO assumption checks
m_clm <- clm(score_ord ~ Treatment * Month, data = df_use, link = "logit")

# Proportional-odds / parallel-slopes checks
nominal_test(m_clm)   # non-parallel (nominal) effects
scale_test(m_clm)     # heterogeneity in scale

```



E means
```{r}
# === 1. EMmeans contrasts ===
emm_trt <- emmeans(m_ord, ~ Treatment | Month,
                   mode = "linear.predictor")

# Dunnett vs Healthy control within each month
contr_q1 <- contrast(emm_trt,
                     method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
                     ref    = "Non-treated control",
                     adjust = "dunnettx")

contr_results <- summary(contr_q1, infer = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame()

print(contr_results)

# === 2. Letter groupings per month ===
cld_results <- multcomp::cld(emm_trt,
                              adjust  = "tukey",
                              Letters = letters,
                              alpha   = 0.05) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(.group = trimws(.group))

print(cld_results)

# === 3. Get back-transformed means for plotting ===
# Use cum prob mode for interpretable scale
emm_resp <- emmeans(m_ord, ~ Treatment | Month,
                    mode = "prob") %>%
  as.data.frame()

print(emm_resp)
```

Plots
```{r}
# === Plot 1: Stacked bar - proportion per score category ===
library(tidyverse)

prop_data <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Month, score) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Month) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    score     = factor(score, levels = 0:5),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c(
      "Non-treated control",
      "Copper standard",
      "Cons1 (Pb39 and Pb177)",
      "Streptomyces sp. Pb39",
      "Pseudathrobacter sp. Pb177"
    )),
    Month = factor(Month, levels = c("August", "September"))
  )

# Color palette for scores 0-5
score_colors <- c(
  "0" = "#1a9850",   # green  - none
  "1" = "#91cf60",   # light green - very minor
  "2" = "#fee08b",   # yellow - minor
  "3" = "#fc8d59",   # orange - moderate
  "4" = "#d73027",   # red    - major
  "5" = "#7b0000"    # dark red - severe
)

p_stacked <- ggplot(prop_data,
                    aes(x = Treatment, y = prop, fill = score)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = score_colors,
    name   = "Disease severity score",
    labels = c(
      "0" = "0 - None (0%)",
      "1" = "1 - Very minor (1-5%)",
      "2" = "2 - Minor (6-15%)",
      "3" = "3 - Moderate (16-30%)",
      "4" = "4 - Major (31-60%)",
      "5" = "5 - Severe (>60%)"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Month, ncol = 1) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Diseased leaf area (%)"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45,
                                    vjust = 1, hjust = 1,
                                    face = "italic"),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 13),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_stacked

ggsave(
  filename = "BDS field trial.tiff",
  plot = p_stacked,
  path = "~/Ad_Planta_Trials/Outputfiles/Plots",
  width = 7.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, units = "in",
  device = "tiff", compression = "lzw"
)


```
